### S2. DERIVATION OF THE DYNAMIC RESPONSE AND LE CHATELIER'S PRINCIPLE
This section provides the detailed derivations of the dynamic response and the evolutionary Le Chatelier relation presented in the main text.

We consider an environmental shift  $ \Delta\alpha $ at t = 0, defined as  $ \frac{d\alpha}{dt} = \Delta\alpha\delta(t) $. Prior to the shift, y is optimized, satisfying  $ \left.\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}\right|_{t=0^{-}} = 0 $,  $ F_{yy} < 0 $, and  $ \det H = F_{xx}F_{yy} - F_{xy}^{2} > 0 $.
